```{r, setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '.')
```


```{r,message=FALSE}
library(IRanges)
library(igraph)
source("../lib_pathway_enrichment.R")
```


# Download annotations
```{r,eval=FALSE}
# Ontology
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/get/br:br08901/json","kegg_brite_br08901_pathways.json")
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/get/br:ko00002/json","kegg_brite_ko00002_modules.json")

# Mouse annotations
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/mmu","kegg_link_mmu_pathway.tsv")
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/module/mmu","kegg_link_mmu_module.tsv")
```


# Parse ontology and annotations
```{r}
H <- disjoint_union(
 brite_ontology_from_json(file="kegg_brite_br08901_pathways.json",root="path"),
 brite_ontology_from_json(file="kegg_brite_ko00002_modules.json",root="md")
)

Ann <- unique(rbind(
  read_kegg_link("kegg_link_pae_pathway.tsv"),
  read_kegg_link("kegg_link_pae_module.tsv")
))
stopifnot(all(Ann$pathway_id %in% V(H)$pathway_id))
Ann <- merge(Ann,as_data_frame(H,"v")[c("ontology_id","pathway_id")],by="pathway_id")[c("ontology_id","locus_tag")] # Add ontology_id to the annotations
```


# Graphical representation of the ontology
```{r}
local({
  G <- H - V(H)[pathway_id %in% Ann$pathway_id]
  ggraph(G,"tree",circular=TRUE) + 
    geom_node_point() + 
    geom_edge_link() + 
    coord_equal()
})
```
